bullets.text: Copilot Actions Rollout - **Microsoft** introduces Copilot Actions for Windows Insiders, enabling task automation on local files.
New Windows 11 Builds - **Microsoft** releases Windows 11 Builds 26100.7296 and 26200.7296 to the Release Preview Channel.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - **Microsoft** launches Insider Preview Build 26220.7262 for Dev & Beta Channels, enhancing user experience.
Azure AI Superfactory - **Microsoft** unveils a new AI datacenter in Atlanta, enhancing global AI compute capabilities.
AI-Driven Cybersecurity - **Microsoft** collaborates with **NVIDIA** to enhance real-time immunity against evolving AI-driven security threats.
Trusted Gaming Communities - **Microsoft** supports game developers with security features to enhance player integrity in gaming.
